root_directory.description: Base directory containing game data (maps, resources).

save_directory.description: Directory for saving player profiles, settings, and session state.

log_directory.description: Directory to store server log files.

bind_address.description: IP address the server listens on (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all, or specific IP).

max_players.description: Maximum number of players allowed on the server.

max_players_per_team.description: Maximum number of players per team (e.g., 1v1, 2v2).

server_name.description: Public name of the server shown in the lobby.

server_description.description: Brief description shown next to the server name in the lobby.

public_server.description: Whether to register with the official master server for public listing.

admin_email.description: Contact email for server administrators (visible in public listings).

password.description: Server password required to join (leave empty for public access).

max_rounds.description: Number of rounds per match (0 = unlimited).

round_time.description: Round time in seconds before automatic end (0 = no time limit).

wall_destruction.description: Allow players to destroy arena walls with their cycles.

player_collisions.description: Enable collisions between player cycles (trails only).

trail_visibility.description: Make trail segments visible after the player passes.

lighting.description: Enable dynamic lighting effects on trails and walls.

sound.description: Enable in-game sound effects (clients must also support it).

default_map.description: Name of the default map (must exist in maps/ folder).

map_rotation.description: List of maps to use in rotation. Each entry defines a name and file path relative to rootDirectory.

path.description: Relative path to the map file (e.g., 'maps/grid.map').

admin_ips.description: List of IP addresses allowed to use admin commands (e.g., /kick, /ban).

restart_on_crash.description: Automatically restart the server if it crashes.

cpu_limit.description: Maximum CPU usage percentage allowed (0 = no limit).

extra_config_file.description: Optional path to additional config file (e.g., 'advanced.conf').

extra_lines.description: Raw additional configuration lines (for advanced or undocumented options).
